definitions.explanation: Describing someone or something that relies excessively on another person, substance, or system. Often carries a negative connotation suggesting unhealthy dependence.

examples.japanese: {依存的|いそんてき}な⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: A dependent relationship is not healthy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{依存的|いそんてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧がちだ。
examples.english: He tends to have a dependent attitude toward his parents.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{依存的|いそんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{日常生活|にちじょうせいかつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支障|ししょう}→支障：12934_shishou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you become too dependent on your smartphone, it can interfere with daily life.

notes:
Formed from {依存|いそん} (dependence) plus the adjectival suffix ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧. Primarily used in psychology, relationships, and social commentary. Almost always carries a negative connotation — healthy reliance is usually expressed differently.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {依存的|いそんてき}な⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: dependent relationship
- {依存的|いそんてき}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: dependent personality
- {依存的|いそんてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: dependent attitude
- {依存的|いそんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become dependent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {依存|いそん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to depend on — the verb form; more neutral than {依存的|いそんてき}
- ⟦{甘|あま}えた→甘える：06624_amaeru⟧: spoiled; clingy — describes dependency in a more emotional, interpersonal way
- ⟦{自立|じりつ}→自立：13970_jiritsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧: independent; self-reliant — the antonym

PRONUNCIATION:
The reading いそん is now standard, though the older pronunciation いぞん is still heard.
